name: Atrest 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ATREST 25MG TABLET

ATREST 25MG TABLET contains Tetrabenazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vesicular monoamine transporter 2 inhibitors. ATREST 25MG TABLET is used to manage diseases that cause hyperkinetic motor disorders (such as jerky, irregular, uncontrollable movements) associated with Huntington's chorea (an inherited neurodegenerative disease) in affected individuals.

ATREST 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Tetrabenazine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from Parkinson-like symptoms, depression, active suicidal thoughts, pheochromocytoma (tumor of the adrenal gland), and/or kidney disorders.

Before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are intolerant to certain sugars (such as lactose), and/or have heart problems (such as long QT syndrome, heart rhythm disorders), liver problems (such as mild, moderate/severe hepatic disorders).

ATREST 25MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ATREST 25MG TABLET are confusion, anxiety, sleeplessness, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage diseases that cause hyperkinetic motor disorders (such as jerky, irregular, uncontrollable movements) associated with Huntington's chorea (an inherited neurodegenerative disease) in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of ATREST 25MG TABLET
Manage diseases that cause hyperkinetic motor disorders (such as jerky, irregular, uncontrollable movements) associated with Huntington's chorea (an inherited neurodegenerative disease) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ATREST 25MG TABLET Works

ATREST 25MG TABLET works by inhibiting the absorption of certain chemicals (dopamine, serotonin) in brain which results in improved movements thus managing hyperkinetic motor disorders associated with Huntington's chorea in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ATREST 25MG TABLET

Take ATREST 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Parkinson-like symptoms (such as uncontrollable movements of the head, legs, hands, arms)
Signs of Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (life threatening reaction to antipsychotic drug) such as mental changes (confusion, hallucinations), stiffness in muscles, and/or temperature
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ATREST 25MG TABLET
Common
Drowsiness (with higher dosages)
Parkinson-like symptoms (such as uncontrollable movements of the head, legs, hands, arms)
Confusion, anxiety
Sleeplessness
Low blood pressure
Dysphagia (difficulty in swallowing)
Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation
Sweating
Uncommon
Mental changes (such as confusion, hallucinations)
Stiffness in your muscles
Fever
Rare
Signs of Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (life threatening reaction to antipsychotic drug) such as mental changes (confusion, hallucinations), stiffness in muscles, and/or temperature

Stop taking ATREST 25MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Feeling sad/depressed
Suicidal thoughts
Have/plan to hurt yourself intentionally

warnings.details: ATREST 25MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ATREST 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive/operate machines if you feel drowsy after taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ATREST 25MG TABLET since the medicine may make you feel abnormally sleepy.
ATREST 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disorders. Consult your doctor before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.
ATREST 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as mild, moderate, and/or severe hepatic disorders. Consult your doctor before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.
Do not take ATREST 25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tetrabenazine, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ATREST 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as long QT syndrome, and/or problems associated with heart rhythm. Consult your doctor before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.

Others

ATREST 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from Parkinson-like symptoms
Are diagnosed with depression which has not been managed or difficult to manage
Have active suicidal thoughts
Have pheochromocytoma (tumor of the adrenal gland)
Have prolactin-dependent tumors such as pituitary/ breast cancer

Before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are a slow/intermediate metabolizer of an enzyme called CYP2D6 (enzyme responsible for metabolism of medicines)
Are intolerant to certain sugars such as lactose

Use in Pediatrics:

ATREST 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).  Consult your doctor before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.

Use in Geriatrics:

ATREST 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above).  Consult your doctor before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ATREST 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Reserpine (used to control high blood pressure and manage psychosis)
Antidepressants (used to manage depression) such as MAO inhibitors (Ex. phenelzine, selegiline)
Levodopa (used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Opioids (used to control pain) Ex. oxycodone, hydrocodone
Antihypertensive drugs (used to manage high blood pressure) Ex. telmisartan, chlorthalidone
Beta blockers (used to manage heart problems) Ex. acebutolol, atenolol
Medicines used to manage psychotic disorders such as hypnotics (Ex. ambien, belsomra), neuroleptics (Ex. butaperazine)
CYP2D6 inhibitors (medicines used to reduce the metabolism of certain medicines) Ex. fluoxetine, paroxetine, terbinafine, moclobemide, quinidine
Medicines that prolong the QTc interval in the ECG (Ex. haloperidol, droperidol)
Certain antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. gatifloxacin, moxifloxacin
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm conditions (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, sotalol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ATREST 25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are uncontrollable muscle spasms (affecting eyes, head, neck and body), uncontrolled rolling of eyes, excessive blinking of eye, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, sweating, dizziness, feeling cold, confusion, hallucinations, drowsiness, redness/inflammation, and/or tremor.

name: Capnea Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About CAPNEA INJECTION

CAPNEA INJECTION contains Caffeine which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants. It is used to manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies. Primary apnea in premature babies happens due to immature development of baby’s breathing centers.

CAPNEA INJECTION has been shown to reduce the number of episodes of interrupted breathing in premature newborns babies. It can also be used to manage bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) among premature babies.

Before CAPNEA INJECTION is administered, inform your doctor if you child has any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child suffers from seizure disorders, slow weight gain or frequent regurgitation (spitting up of milk or food) as a precaution.

If you are the mother of the premature infant who receives the management, you must not drink coffee or take foods which has high caffeine content. This is because the caffeine taken by the breastfeeding mother may pass through the breast milk to the nursing premature infant who is already receiving caffeine therapy and may lead to an overdosage. The most common side effect of CAPNEA INJECTION is fast or irregular heart rate. Consult your doctor if it worsens.
uses: Manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies
Manage and manages bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) in premature babies
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAPNEA INJECTION
Manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies
Manage and manages bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) in premature babies
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPNEA INJECTION Works

CAPNEA INJECTION is a CNS stimulant. It works by stimulating a part of the brain that controls breathing. As a result, the brain transfers a lot of breathing signals to the lungs which makes the lungs breathe more deeper and faster. It also increases the number of breathing cycles, manages the airway damage and reduces the need for mechanical ventilation.
usageDetails:
How to use CAPNEA INJECTION

CAPNEA INJECTION will be administered by a doctor or a nurse into the vein of the child (intravenous drips). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for your child based on their gestational age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, redness, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or threating and breathing difficulties)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of CAPNEA INJECTION
Common
Fast or irregular heart rate
Increased blood sugar levels

Contact your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects in your child after CAPNEA INJECTION is administered:

Severe bloody stools
Fits
Blood infections (sepsis)
Allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, redness, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or threating and breathing difficulties)

warnings.details: If you are the mother of the premature infant who receives the management, you must not drink coffee or take foods which has high caffeine content. This is because the caffeine taken by the breastfeeding mother may pass through the breast milk to the nursing premature infant who is already receiving caffeine therapy and may lead to an overdosage.
CAPNEA INJECTION should be used with caution in babies with kidney problems. Therefore, inform your doctor as a precaution.
CAPNEA INJECTION should be used with caution in babies with liver problems. Therefore, inform your doctor as a precaution.
If your child is allergic to caffeine, kindly inform your doctor before CAPNEA INJECTION is administered to the child.
CAPNEA INJECTION should be used with caution in babies with heart problems (such as irregular heart rate). Therefore, inform your doctor as a precaution.
CAPNEA INJECTION can be used in premature infants born between 28-33 gestation weeks (7-8 months of pregnancy) under careful medical supervision.

Others

Before CAPNEA INJECTION is administered to the baby, kindly inform the doctor if your baby suffers from any of the following conditions:

Fits
Frequent regurgitation (spitting up of milk or food)
Increased urination
Slow or reduced weight gain or food intake
Increased caffeine intake by the mother before the baby is delivered
Use of antiepileptic medicines by the mother during her pregnancy

name: Cognistar 60mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION contains Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate which belongs to group of medicines called Neurotrophic agents. It is used to manage cranial injury, aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia, cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke, and Alzheimer's disease.

A cranial injury is a head injury causing trauma to the scalp, skull, or brain. It is characterised by symptoms such as leakage of blood outside the blood vessels, uncontrolled bleeding, skull fracture, brain injury, or swelling in the brain.

A stroke occurs when the blood supply to the brain or part of it is blocked. It is characterised by symptoms such as troubled speech, numbness in the body, visual disturbances, headaches, and troubled waking.

Dementia is a group of symptoms such as loss of memory and thinking/reasoning abilities. Alzheimer’s disease is a disorder that causes progressive degeneration of brain cells, resulting in brain shrinkage. It is characterised by dementia, social withdrawal, and wandering.

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal dysfunction, status epilepticus (a life-threatening neurological disorder), or major epilepsia (a seizure that causes loss of consciousness and violent muscle contractions).

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with epilepsy (fits or seizures) and or allergic diathesis (condition causing predisposition to develop group of allergies such as hay fever, allergic rhinitis, bronchial asthma, or atopic dermatitis).

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding females only if it is clearly needed. COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects associated with the use of COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vertigo (sensation of spinning), increased sweating, agitation, fever, and hallucinations. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke (lack of blood supply in the brain)
Manage aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia
Manage Alzheimer’s disease (disease caused due to degeneration of brain cells)

mechanismOfAction:
How COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION Works

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION helps in restoring brain functions where Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate works by protecting nerve cells from toxins and lack of oxygen. It improves the survival ability of nerve cells. It also helps in the formation of new nerve cells, increasing nutrition of brain cells, reducing inflammation of brain tissues, and blocking the release of certain chemicals that may damage brain cells.
usageDetails:
How to use COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION

COGNISTAR 60MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have or ever had any seizures (epilepsy or fits)

name: Modalert 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MODALERT 100MG TABLET

MODALERT 100MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODALERT 100MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODALERT 100MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODALERT 100MG TABLET.

MODALERT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODALERT 100MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODALERT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODALERT 100MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODALERT 100MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MODALERT 100MG TABLET

Manage:

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea
Shift work disorder
Circadian rhythm sleep disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How MODALERT 100MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.
usageDetails:
How to use MODALERT 100MG TABLET

Take MODALERT 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Anxiety and severe agitation

You have or have had depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania or bipolar disorder
Had drug problems in the past
Rare hereditary conditions such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency and Glucose-galactose malabsorption

MODALERT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age as its safety is not yet established in children. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

MODALERT 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years of age as it may require dose adjustments. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MODALERT 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Hormonal contraceptives such as contraceptive pills Ex. Ethinyl oestradiol, implants, intrauterine devices or patches (medicines and devices used for the management of pregnancy)
Omeprazole (a medicine used for the management of acidity, stomach ulcers etc)
Indinavir, ritonavir (a medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Ciclosporin (a medicine used for immune system suppression, to manage arthritis or psoriasis)
Carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin (medicines used for the management of seizures)
Amitriptyline, citalopram, fluoxetine (medicines used for the management of depression)
Diazepam, triazolam (medicines used for the management of anxiety)
Warfarin (medicines used for the management of blood clotting)
Amlodipine, verapamil, propranolol (medicines used for the management of high blood pressure)
Atorvastatin, simvastatin (medicines used for managing high cholesterol levels)
Itraconazole, ketoconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Phenytoin or S-mephenytoin (medicines used to manage fits)
Antipyrine (a medicine used to manage ear infections and pain)
Medicines used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) (such as dextroamphetamine and methylphenidate)

Overdosage:

In case you or anybody else accidentally takes too much of MODALERT 100MG TABLET consult the doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage are feeling sick, disoriented, confused, restless, Insomnia, agitated, nervousness or anxious, difficulty sleeping, hallucinations, excitation high blood pressure, palpitations, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting and chest pain.

introduction:
Introduction About AXEPTA 10MG TABLET

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for AXEPTA 10MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AXEPTA 10MG TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How AXEPTA 10MG TABLET Works

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.
usageDetails:
How to use AXEPTA 10MG TABLET

Take AXEPTA 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. AXEPTA 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

It is not known whether AXEPTA 10MG TABLET can pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.
AXEPTA 10MG TABLET may make you feel dizzy, tired and sleepy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by AXEPTA 10MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.
AXEPTA 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AXEPTA 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AXEPTA 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Atomoxetine.

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patient with serious heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as heart defects or irregular or fast heartbeat). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Before taking AXEPTA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings
Have or ever had fits (or seizures) in the past
Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

Use in paediatrics:

AXEPTA 10MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of AXEPTA 10MG TABLET have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take AXEPTA 10MG TABLET only if advised by your physician.

Introduction About AXEPTA 25MG TABLET

AXEPTA 25MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

AXEPTA 25MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for AXEPTA 25MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking AXEPTA 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

AXEPTA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking AXEPTA 25MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking AXEPTA 25MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About WAKLERT 150MG TABLET

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET contains Armodafinil which belongs to the group of medicines called Wakefulness-promoting agents. It is used to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness due to sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy (uncontrollable daytime sleepiness) or shift work disorder (sleep disorders in those who work out of regular shift time like 9am to 5am).

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET is also used in patients having obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a condition where there is a breathing difficulty while sleeping due to obstruction in the nasal and throat passage.

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having liver, kidney or heart diseases, psychosis or have or had alcohol addiction. WAKLERT 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

 WAKLERT 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking.

The common side effects of taking WAKLERT 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea (feel sick), dizziness, difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if the symptom does not improve or worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WAKLERT 150MG TABLET

Improves wakefulness in adult patients who are sleepy due to sleep disorders such as:

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA)
Shift work disorder (SWD)
mechanismOfAction:
How WAKLERT 150MG TABLET Works

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET works as stimulants which provide long lasting mental arousal. It inhibits the reuptake of a brain chemical called dopamine (supresses sleep), increasing its concentration in the brain. This helps in improving wakefulness in patients having sleeping disorders.

name: ATONEXT 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ATONEXT 10MG TABLET

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATONEXT 10MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ATONEXT 10MG TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How ATONEXT 10MG TABLET Works

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.
usageDetails:
How to use ATONEXT 10MG TABLET

Take ATONEXT 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATONEXT 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

It is not known whether ATONEXT 10MG TABLET can pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.
ATONEXT 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ATONEXT 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ATONEXT 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Atomoxetine.

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patient with serious heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as heart defects or irregular or fast heartbeat). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Before taking ATONEXT 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings
Have or ever had fits (or seizures) in the past
Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

Use in paediatrics:

ATONEXT 10MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ATONEXT 10MG TABLET have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take ATONEXT 10MG TABLET only if advised by your physician.

ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.
usageDetails:
How to use ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE

Take ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of side effects.
ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Atomoxetine.

ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patient with serious heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as heart defects or irregular or fast heartbeat). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Before taking ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings
Have or ever had fits (or seizures) in the past
Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

Use in paediatrics:

ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take ATTENTROL 10MG CAPSULE only if advised by your physician.

name: ATONEXT 25mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ATONEXT 25MG TABLET

ATONEXT 25MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATONEXT 25MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATONEXT 25MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATONEXT 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATONEXT 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATONEXT 25MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATONEXT 25MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET

MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET.

MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.
usageDetails:
How to use MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET

Take MODAFIL MD 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WAKLERT 250MG TABLET

WAKLERT 250MG TABLET contains Armodafinil which belongs to the group of medicines called Wakefulness-promoting agents. It is used to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness due to sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy (uncontrollable daytime sleepiness) or shift work disorder (sleep disorders in those who work out of regular shift time like 9am to 5am).

WAKLERT 250MG TABLET is also used in patients having obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a condition where there is a breathing difficulty while sleeping due to obstruction in the nasal and throat passage.

WAKLERT 250MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having liver, kidney or heart diseases, psychosis or have or had alcohol addiction. WAKLERT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

 WAKLERT 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking.

The common side effects of taking WAKLERT 250MG TABLET are headache, nausea (feel sick), dizziness, difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if the symptom does not improve or worsen.

WAKLERT 250MG TABLET works as stimulants which provide long lasting mental arousal. It inhibits the reuptake of a brain chemical called dopamine (supresses sleep), increasing its concentration in the brain. This helps in improving wakefulness in patients having sleeping disorders.

introduction:
Introduction About MODAPRO 200MG TABLET

MODAPRO 200MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODAPRO 200MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODAPRO 200MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODAPRO 200MG TABLET.

MODAPRO 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODAPRO 200MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODAPRO 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODAPRO 200MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODAPRO 200MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How MODAPRO 200MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.

Take MODAPRO 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE

ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTENTROL 40 MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About MODATEC 200MG TABLET

MODATEC 200MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODATEC 200MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODATEC 200MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODATEC 200MG TABLET.

MODATEC 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODATEC 200MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODATEC 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODATEC 200MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODATEC 200MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea
Shift work disorder
Circadian rhythm sleep disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How MODATEC 200MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.

Take MODATEC 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About WAKLERT 150MG TABLET

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET contains Armodafinil which belongs to the group of medicines called Wakefulness-promoting agents. It is used to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness due to sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy (uncontrollable daytime sleepiness) or shift work disorder (sleep disorders in those who work out of regular shift time like 9am to 5am).

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET is also used in patients having obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a condition where there is a breathing difficulty while sleeping due to obstruction in the nasal and throat passage.

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having liver, kidney or heart diseases, psychosis or have or had alcohol addiction. WAKLERT 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

 WAKLERT 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking.

The common side effects of taking WAKLERT 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea (feel sick), dizziness, difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if the symptom does not improve or worsen.

WAKLERT 150MG TABLET works as stimulants which provide long lasting mental arousal. It inhibits the reuptake of a brain chemical called dopamine (supresses sleep), increasing its concentration in the brain. This helps in improving wakefulness in patients having sleeping disorders.

introduction:
Introduction About ATTERA 10MG TABLET

ATTERA 10MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTERA 10MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTERA 10MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTERA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTERA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTERA 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTERA 10MG TABLET.

ATTERA 10MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATTERA 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

introduction:
Introduction About AXEPTA 60MG TABLET

AXEPTA 60MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

AXEPTA 60MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for AXEPTA 60MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking AXEPTA 60MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

AXEPTA 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking AXEPTA 60MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking AXEPTA 60MG TABLET.

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How AXEPTA 60MG TABLET Works

AXEPTA 60MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

Take AXEPTA 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. AXEPTA 60MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking AXEPTA 60MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

introduction:
Introduction About WAKLERT 50 TABLET

WAKLERT 50 TABLET contains Armodafinil which belongs to the group of medicines called Wakefulness-promoting agents. It is used to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness due to sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy (uncontrollable daytime sleepiness) or shift work disorder (sleep disorders in those who work out of regular shift time like 9am to 5am).

WAKLERT 50 TABLET is also used in patients having obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a condition where there is a breathing difficulty while sleeping due to obstruction in the nasal and throat passage.

WAKLERT 50 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having liver, kidney or heart diseases, psychosis or have or had alcohol addiction. WAKLERT 50 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

 WAKLERT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking.

The common side effects of taking WAKLERT 50 TABLET are headache, nausea (feel sick), dizziness, difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if the symptom does not improve or worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WAKLERT 50 TABLET

Improves wakefulness in adult patients who are sleepy due to sleep disorders such as:

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA)
Shift work disorder (SWD)
mechanismOfAction:
How WAKLERT 50 TABLET Works

WAKLERT 50 TABLET works as stimulants which provide long lasting mental arousal. It inhibits the reuptake of a brain chemical called dopamine (supresses sleep), increasing its concentration in the brain. This helps in improving wakefulness in patients having sleeping disorders.

Take WAKLERT 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TOMKID 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. introduction:
Introduction About MODATEC 100MG TABLET

MODATEC 100MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODATEC 100MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODATEC 100MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODATEC 100MG TABLET.

MODATEC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODATEC 100MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODATEC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODATEC 100MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODATEC 100MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How MODATEC 100MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About ATOKEM 10MG TABLET

ATOKEM 10MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATOKEM 10MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATOKEM 10MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATOKEM 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATOKEM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATOKEM 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATOKEM 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATOKEM 10MG TABLET Works

ATOKEM 10MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

Take ATOKEM 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATOKEM 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATOKEM 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

Others

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings

Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

Use in paediatrics:

ATOKEM 10MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ATOKEM 10MG TABLET have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take ATOKEM 10MG TABLET only if advised by your physician.

name: METADOOP 200 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About METADOOP 200 TABLET

METADOOP 200 TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. METADOOP 200 TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with METADOOP 200 TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking METADOOP 200 TABLET.

METADOOP 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. METADOOP 200 TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

METADOOP 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. METADOOP 200 TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking METADOOP 200 TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How METADOOP 200 TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About ATONEXT 18 TABLET

ATONEXT 18 TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATONEXT 18 TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATONEXT 18 TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATONEXT 18 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATONEXT 18 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATONEXT 18 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATONEXT 18 TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ATONEXT 18 TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How ATONEXT 18 TABLET Works

ATONEXT 18 TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.
usageDetails:
How to use ATONEXT 18 TABLET

Take ATONEXT 18 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATONEXT 18 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATONEXT 18 TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

It is not known whether ATONEXT 18 TABLET can pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

ATONEXT 18 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ATONEXT 18 TABLET if you are allergic to Atomoxetine.

ATONEXT 18 TABLET is not recommended for use in patient with serious heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as heart defects or irregular or fast heartbeat). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ATONEXT 18 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Before taking ATONEXT 18 TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings
Have or ever had fits (or seizures) in the past
Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

Use in paediatrics:

ATONEXT 18 TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ATONEXT 18 TABLET have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take ATONEXT 18 TABLET only if advised by your physician.

Introduction About ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE

ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTENTIN 25MG CAPSULE.

Introduction About ATTERA 25MG TABLET

ATTERA 25MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTERA 25MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTERA 25MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTERA 25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTERA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTERA 25MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTERA 25MG TABLET.

ATTERA 25MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.
