introduction:
Introduction About PROVAKE 200MG TABLET

PROVAKE 200MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. PROVAKE 200MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with PROVAKE 200MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking PROVAKE 200MG TABLET.

PROVAKE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. PROVAKE 200MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

PROVAKE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. PROVAKE 200MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking PROVAKE 200MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

Obstructive sleep apnoea
Shift work disorder
Circadian rhythm sleep disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How PROVAKE 200MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.

Take PROVAKE 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE.

How ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE Works

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. Take ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

Others

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow angle glaucoma
Have stroke or any condition that affects blood vessels in brain (such as aneurysm, narrow or blocked blood vessels)
Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal glands)

Have thoughts of suicide or harming/killing yourself
Have high blood pressure or low blood pressure
Have a history of stroke
Have hallucinations (seeing or believing things that aren’t true) or any other psychotic problems
Have mania (a mood disorder that causes high levels of excitement)
Feel angry, unfriendly or unhappy
Have mood swings
Have or ever had fits (or seizures) in the past
Have uncontrollable twitching of body parts
Constantly repeat abnormal sounds or words (Tic disorder)

ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE can be used in children and adolescents (aged above 6 years) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE have not been established in elderly patients. Therefore, take ATTENTIN 10MG CAPSULE only if advised by your physician.

introduction:
Introduction About ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE

ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE.

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE Works

ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

Take ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATTENTIN 18MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

name: Provake 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PROVAKE 100MG TABLET

PROVAKE 100MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. PROVAKE 100MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with PROVAKE 100MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking PROVAKE 100MG TABLET.

PROVAKE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. PROVAKE 100MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

PROVAKE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. PROVAKE 100MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking PROVAKE 100MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PROVAKE 100MG TABLET

Manage:

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea
Shift work disorder
Circadian rhythm sleep disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How PROVAKE 100MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.
usageDetails:

Take PROVAKE 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ARMOD 150MG TABLET

ARMOD 150MG TABLET contains Armodafinil which belongs to the group of medicines called Wakefulness-promoting agents. It is used to improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness due to sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy (uncontrollable daytime sleepiness) or shift work disorder (sleep disorders in those who work out of regular shift time like 9am to 5am).

ARMOD 150MG TABLET is also used in patients having obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a condition where there is a breathing difficulty while sleeping due to obstruction in the nasal and throat passage.

ARMOD 150MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having liver, kidney or heart diseases, psychosis or have or had alcohol addiction. ARMOD 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

 ARMOD 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking.

The common side effects of taking ARMOD 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea (feel sick), dizziness, difficulty in sleeping. Consult your doctor if the symptom does not improve or worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ARMOD 150MG TABLET

Improves wakefulness in adult patients who are sleepy due to sleep disorders such as:

Narcolepsy
Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA)
Shift work disorder (SWD)
mechanismOfAction:
How ARMOD 150MG TABLET Works

ARMOD 150MG TABLET works as stimulants which provide long lasting mental arousal. It inhibits the reuptake of a brain chemical called dopamine (supresses sleep), increasing its concentration in the brain. This helps in improving wakefulness in patients having sleeping disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ARMOD 150MG TABLET

Take ARMOD 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ATOKEM 18MG TABLET

ATOKEM 18MG TABLET contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATOKEM 18MG TABLET is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATOKEM 18MG TABLET to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATOKEM 18MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATOKEM 18MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATOKEM 18MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATOKEM 18MG TABLET.

ATOKEM 18MG TABLET effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

Take ATOKEM 18MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATOKEM 18MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATOKEM 18MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

introduction:
Introduction About ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE

ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE contains Atomoxetine which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychostimulants. It is used to manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years).

ADHD is a mental disorder in which the affected patient remains impulsive, less attentive and/or hyperactive. It is predominant in children and in young adults and is often characterised by troublesome symptoms that can affect their daily life (such as lack of focus or concentration, aggressive behaviour, hyperactivity, forgetfulness, fidgety, daydreaming and restlessness)

ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE is used along with counselling and behavioural therapy to achieve better results. It may take few weeks for ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE to improve your symptoms. Therefore, take this medicine for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, high or low blood pressure, stroke, any problems in blood circulation, fits or any other mood disorders (such as mania, mood swings, aggression, hallucinations) as a precaution.

ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, high blood pressure, tiredness, weight loss and difficulty in reaching orgasm. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor if you feel extremely depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE.

Uses Of ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged above 6 years) to:

Manage Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
mechanismOfAction:
How ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE Works

ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE effectively controls the symptoms of ADHD, where atomoxetine acts by increasing the amount of certain chemicals (such as noradrenaline) within the brain that controls impulsiveness and hyperactivity. It can also improve attention span and reduces the signs of ADHD in the affected patients.

How to use ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE

Take ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking ATTENTROL 18MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again.

introduction:
Introduction About MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET

MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET contains Modafinil, which belongs to a group of medicines known as Psychostimulants. It is used for the management of Narcolepsy in adult patients. MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET is also used for the management of obstructive sleep apnoea (obstruction of the airway during sleep), circadian rhythm sleep disorder and shift work disorder. 

Narcolepsy can be defined as a rare long-term neural condition in which the sleep-regulating mechanism of the brain is altered. Narcolepsy can lead to excessive daytime sleepiness, lack of concentration, sleep attacks (suddenly falling asleep), cataplexy (temporary loss of muscle control leading to weakness and falling), sleep paralysis (it is a temporary inability to move or speak during waking up or falling asleep), excessive dreaming and waking in the middle of the night.

During management with MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET, your doctor may request a test for your heart called an electrocardiogram (ECG). You may also be monitored for your blood pressure and heart rate while you are taking MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET.

MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from uncontrolled or moderate to severe high blood pressure and arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) or who had a heart attack. MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET, should be used with caution in patients who have had liver diseases, kidney diseases, depression, anxiety, low mood, psychosis, mania, bipolar disorder, are alcoholic and recreational drug abuse.

MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Specific serious side effects may include depression, aggression or hostility towards other people or suicidal thoughts or other changes in your behaviour.  Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any such side effects.

The most common side effect of taking MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, insomnia (inability to fall asleep), nervousness, anxiety, stuffy nose, back pain, extreme tiredness, weakness, palpitations, chest pain, dry mouth, redness of the face, loss of appetite, nausea, stomach-ache, indigestion, diarrhoea or constipation, blurred vision, irritability, numbness or tingling sensation in hands or feet, abnormal liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of your side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET Works

Modafinil is a psychostimulant which acts on Orexin neurons. Orexin neurons are nerve cells found in the brain which regulate sleep/wake states. Modafinil activates orexin neurons and hence induces wakefulness and reduces the likelihood that you will have sleep attacks.
usageDetails:
How to use MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET

Take MODAFIL MD 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Consume the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
